start.relative: UBW route days one to three

end.relative: UBW route day three return from church

timelineNodes.label: Common opening diverges
timelineNodes.summary: The opening follows Fate route until Saber tries to attack Archer and Rin.

timelineNodes.label: Command Spell stop
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou uses a Command Spell to stop Saber and Rin takes him to the church.

timelineNodes.label: Berserker retreat
timelineNodes.summary: Illya retreats after Archer's Caladbolg-like attack injures Saber.

events.cause: UBW route diverges from the Fate opening through Shirou's use of a Command Spell and Archer's intervention.
events.process: Saber is stopped from attacking Rin and Archer; after the church explanation, the party encounters Illya and Berserker.
events.outcome: Archer survives the opening and Illya becomes interested in him before retreating.
stateChanges: Saber is injured by Archer's indiscriminate shot
relationshipChanges: Rin and Shirou move toward alliance while Archer remains hostile to Shirou

timelineNodes.label: UBW vision
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou sees the Unlimited Blade Works landscape in a vision.

timelineNodes.label: Caster thread
timelineNodes.summary: Rin and Archer infer Caster is draining magical energy at Ryuudou Temple; Caster later tries to seize Shirou's Command Spells.

timelineNodes.label: Rider killed
timelineNodes.summary: The school barrier activates and Rider is found killed by an unknown attacker, later inferred as Kuzuki's side.

events.cause: Caster's hidden base and Rider's school barrier drive the investigation phase.
events.process: Caster tries to take Shirou's Command Spells, Archer saves him but spares Caster, then the school barrier incident reveals Rider has been killed.
events.outcome: Caster remains active, Rider is eliminated early, and Archer's willingness to kill Shirou becomes explicit.

timelineNodes.label: Borrowed ideal recognized
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou realizes his ideal is borrowed from Kiritsugu.

timelineNodes.label: Kuzuki identified
timelineNodes.summary: Rin and Shirou identify Kuzuki as Caster's Master.

timelineNodes.label: Projection overload
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou projects Kanshou and Bakuya to protect Rin, then suffers circuit overload and Archer treats him while attacking his ideal.

events.cause: The search for Caster's Master intersects with Shirou's growing Archer-like combat style.
events.process: Shinji gains Gilgamesh through Kirei, Kuzuki is identified, and the ambush shows Kuzuki overpowering Saber while Shirou uses projection to save Rin.
events.outcome: Shirou's projection path becomes route-central and Archer intensifies ideological pressure.
stateChanges: Shinji gains Gilgamesh as a new Servant
Shirou suffers partial numbness from projection overload
relationshipChanges: Rin becomes more directly protected by Shirou
Archer frames Shirou's ideal as false

timelineNodes.label: Taiga hostage
timelineNodes.summary: Caster attacks the Emiya residence and takes Taiga hostage.

timelineNodes.label: Saber contract severed
timelineNodes.summary: Caster uses Rule Breaker on Saber, cuts her contract, and controls her.

timelineNodes.label: Archer's betrayal
timelineNodes.summary: Archer appears to betray Rin and joins Caster, while allowing Rin and Shirou to escape.

events.cause: Caster targets Shirou's Command Spells and Saber to consolidate war control.
events.process: Shirou gives up Command Spells to save Taiga, Saber is taken with Rule Breaker, and Archer defects in a staged betrayal.
events.outcome: Shirou loses Master status, Saber becomes Caster-controlled, Rin loses Archer, and Shirou and Rin deepen trust after escape.
relationshipChanges: Shirou and Rin confess feelings and identify the twin-pendant clue

timelineNodes.label: Caster past revealed
timelineNodes.summary: Caster's betrayal past is revealed and Shirou dreams of the Fuyuki fire.

timelineNodes.label: Illya killed
timelineNodes.summary: Gilgamesh kills Berserker and removes Illya's heart while Shinji mocks.

timelineNodes.label: Lancer offers alliance
timelineNodes.summary: Lancer intervenes and proposes alliance with Rin and Shirou.

events.cause: Rin and Shirou seek Illya as an ally against Caster, but Gilgamesh has already attacked.
events.process: The party arrives too late; Gilgamesh kills Berserker and Illya, then Lancer joins Rin and Shirou out of opposition to Gilgamesh and Archer.
events.outcome: Illya and Berserker are eliminated in UBW, and Lancer becomes a temporary ally.
stateChanges: Lancer shifts into alliance with Rin/Shirou
relationshipChanges: Lancer opposes Gilgamesh and Archer alongside Rin/Shirou

timelineNodes.label: Lancer vs Archer
timelineNodes.summary: Lancer uses Gae Bolg and Archer blocks with Rho Aias.

timelineNodes.label: Caster killed
timelineNodes.summary: Rin fights Caster, and Archer kills Caster and Kuzuki after revealing the betrayal was a ploy.

timelineNodes.label: Archer identity
timelineNodes.summary: Archer reveals he is Shirou from the future, sets a duel for the next day, and abducts Rin.

events.cause: Rin, Shirou, Saber, and Lancer attack Caster's church position.
events.process: Lancer fights Archer, Rin and Shirou oppose Caster and Kuzuki, Archer kills Caster's side, then turns on Shirou and opens Unlimited Blade Works.
events.outcome: Caster and Kuzuki are eliminated, Saber contracts with Rin, Archer's identity is revealed, and Rin is kidnapped.
relationshipChanges: Archer and Shirou become explicit same-entity conflict variants

timelineNodes.label: Lancer saves Rin
timelineNodes.summary: Lancer refuses Kirei's order to kill Rin and dies by Command Spell-forced suicide, then retaliates.

timelineNodes.label: Shirou vs Archer
timelineNodes.summary: Archer reveals his despair as a Counter Guardian; Shirou accepts the ideal as hypocritical but beautiful.

timelineNodes.label: Shinji vessel
timelineNodes.summary: Gilgamesh reveals the Grail as Angra Mainyu and implants Illya's heart in Shinji as vessel.

events.cause: Archer demands a duel with Shirou while Gilgamesh moves toward Grail completion using Rin and Shinji.
events.process: Lancer rescues Rin, Shirou defeats Archer ideologically and physically under Avalon support, and Gilgamesh reveals the polluted Grail vessel plan.
events.outcome: Archer is defeated but later protects Shirou, Lancer and Kirei are removed from the route conflict, and Shinji becomes the Grail vessel.
stateChanges: Kirei is burned after Lancer's retaliation
relationshipChanges: Shirou rejects Archer's despair while retaining the same ideal
Rin supports Shirou's route away from Archer's fate

timelineNodes.label: Ryuudou finale
timelineNodes.summary: Saber defeats Assassin and destroys the Grail with Excalibur.

timelineNodes.label: UBW beats Gate of Babylon
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou opens Unlimited Blade Works and counters Gate of Babylon, then Archer shoots Gilgamesh.

timelineNodes.label: Route ending variants
timelineNodes.summary: Good Ending keeps Saber present; True Ending sends Shirou and Rin to London while Saber disappears reconciled.

events.cause: Gilgamesh tries to complete the corrupted Grail using Shinji as the vessel.
events.process: Saber eliminates Assassin and destroys the Grail while Shirou's Unlimited Blade Works counters Gilgamesh until Archer finishes the battle.
events.outcome: Gilgamesh is defeated, Archer departs reconciled, and the route branches into Good and True endings.
relationshipChanges: Archer asks Rin to care for his past self
Shirou and Rin continue together in True Ending
